reason: In the first test, apps/web/playwright/login.2fa.e2e.ts:44-53 goes straight from fillOtp to the two-factor-switch check with no backup-codes-close click, while the patch moved onEnable() from handleEnable (EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx:134-136 now only sets DisplayBackupCodes) into that button's onClick. So viewer.me is never invalidated and the switch is not checked; the test only passes because `expect(promise).toBeTruthy()` at line 53 is vacuous, as the patch's own FIXME at lines 50-51 admits.
